integrity: Complete written proof and standalone numerical cross-check; numerical calculations are corroborative, not independent or infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: The exact order-statistic law holds for arbitrary flat torus inversion quotients, but the elementary CDF and fixed-area stochastic shape comparison are proved only for planar rectangular tori. Priority may be affected by older unindexed orbifold-distance literature; full Silverman (1978) text was unavailable.
title: Sharp stochastic distance ordering for rectangular flat pillowcases
